# Valid September snapshot

The Alder sofa in oat is listed as available for standard dispatch. Slate is listed with an estimated three-week replenishment window. Forest green is made to order with an estimated six-to-eight-week production range. The Rowan king bed in natural oak is listed as available.

Availability is a dated informational snapshot and may change before checkout. It is not a reservation or stock promise. Customers should confirm current availability with a manager before making time-sensitive plans.
